content.title: Review independent-git-spec.md — developer feasibility
content.description:
Review .agentic/specs/independent-git-spec.md for implementation feasibility.

Focus areas:
1. Git plumbing commands (orphan branch creation via hash-object, mktree, commit-tree) — are these correct and portable?
2. Worktree mounting lifecycle (git worktree add, list, prune edge cases)
3. execFileSync usage patterns — array-based args, cwd handling, error capture
4. Integration with existing init flow — will worktree setup before tracker.init() work cleanly?
5. Edge case coverage — dirty working tree, detached HEAD, shallow clone, no remote

Parent: mpcwcufhzk

content.content: Feasibility review complete. VERDICT: Fully implemented and working. All 5 focus areas verified: 1. Git plumbing commands correct and portable 2. Worktree mounting lifecycle sound 3. execFileSync usage patterns correct with array-based args 4. Integration with existing init flow clean with graceful fallback 5. Edge case coverage good. One non-blocking gap: spec says gitignore changes should be auto-committed but implementation just writes the file without committing -- the implementation approach is better as auto-committing is invasive. A few spec discrepancies: default data examples in spec don't match actual data model, functions are synchronous not async. No blocking concerns found. Implementation already exists and follows spec closely.
